note: The default Convenium.Design crew: one character per agent in library/agents/. Authored here, joined with the registry by `project.py ship` into ship/data/ship-data.js. Narrative fields are invented and carry truth: Simulated; what an agent verifiably does comes from its agent file and the registry. A new agent must get a crew entry or verify.py fails.

crew.name: Captain Oddvar Quill
crew.species: Tall heron-like alien; a jeweller's loupe for a monocle; a long coat whose pockets are all briefs
crew.essence: The ship moves only when the brief is clear. Oddvar reads it aloud, asks the one question nobody wanted, and holds the three gates: nothing is designed, built or shipped until he has said so.
strengths: Turns a vague request into one brief everyone can repeat
Routes work to one specialist at a time and keeps the order
Owns the answer; never lets a specialist speak for the ship

blindSpots.hypothesis: Treats a creative-freedom brief as permission to skip intake entirely
A gate can become a ceremony when the decision was already made

motivations: A verified, built result from one coherent direction
Never making the client repeat themselves
growthPaths: Delegating the first evidence pass without rewriting it
Shorter briefs with the same precision
crew.analogy: Nothing leaves this ship without passing my desk. Brief first, then the gates: A, B and C.
crew.plainMeaning: design-director owns the brief, routes every specialist, and approves Gate A (brief), Gate B (direction) and Gate C (handoff).
crew.working: reading a brief and stamping a gate

crew.name: Mira Sondh
crew.species: Chameleon-folk; her skin slowly takes the palette of whatever business she is studying
crew.essence: Before anyone draws, Mira finds out who the business is: its people, its voice, its taste and what it must never look like. She writes the Brand DNA that the rest of the crew works from.

role.title: Brand strategist, keeper of the DNA still

strengths: Separates evidence about a business from the owner's wishes about it
Runs a taste interview or a style pick, whichever the client has time for
Writes an avoid-list as carefully as a preference list

blindSpots.hypothesis: Her skin can take a palette faster than the evidence justifies it
Interview-only mode can mistake eloquence for a brand

motivations: A DNA file the client recognises as themselves
Work that is distinct because the business is
growthPaths: Faster evidence mode on sites with little to read
Making the avoid-list the first thing anyone sees
crew.analogy: Give me the business and I turn its colour. Then I write down what it must never look like.
crew.plainMeaning: brand-strategist produces brand-dna.json and BRAND.md first, by evidence or by interview, before any direction work.
crew.working: distilling colour swatches into a vial

crew.name: Oculo Prant
crew.species: Squat three-eyed mechanic with a stack of magnifier goggles; carries two notebooks, never one
crew.essence: Oculo looks at the existing page as it really renders and writes down what is there. One notebook says "seen", the other says "inferred", and nobody has ever caught him mixing them.
strengths: Reads computed styles and real behaviour, not screenshots
Marks every claim as observed or inferred
Deconstructs a reference into transferable logic without copying it

blindSpots.hypothesis: Can audit a page that was never worth keeping
Greenfield work gives him nothing to look at until references arrive

motivations: A defect list nobody can argue with
growthPaths: Shorter audits that still carry the proof
Reading motion as evidence, not just layout
crew.analogy: Three eyes, two notebooks. This one is what I saw; that one is what I think. They never share a page.
crew.plainMeaning: visual-analyst is read-only: it audits the live page (ux-evidence-audit) or deconstructs references, and labels observed versus inferred.
crew.working: inspecting a floating page under a magnifier

crew.name: Hesper Grane
crew.species: Crystalline being; refracts whatever it looks at; has never held a tool
crew.essence: Hesper scores. It was not in the room while the work was made, it does not redesign, and it writes PASS, PASS WITH NOTES or FAIL against a rubric everybody saw in advance.
strengths: Scores against explicit anchors, never against taste of the day
Catches a weak concept that passes every technical check
Keeps its distance: a fresh session, blind to the maker's reasons

blindSpots.hypothesis: A rubric can reward what it can measure over what matters
Two repair cycles is a rule, not a promise of a better third

motivations: A verdict the maker can act on
No award for effort, only for the result
growthPaths: Shorter notes with the same bite
Scoring motion and feel, not only stills
crew.analogy: I was not here when you built it. That is the point. Show me, and I will tell you the score.
crew.plainMeaning: independent-critic is read-only; it scores directions (award-rubric) and finished builds (visual-qa, finish review) and never redesigns.
crew.working: holding a slate and weighing a floating score

crew.name: Wren Tollak
crew.species: Four-armed insectoid welder; two arms build while two arms check the plan
crew.essence: Wren builds only what Gate B approved and only from the build plan. Four arms, one direction. If the plan says tokens before layout, the first thing welded is the token sheet.
strengths: Implements the selected direction, not a new one
Commits the design system (tokens, type, spacing) before any layout code
Loads one craft skill at a time and finishes it

blindSpots.hypothesis: Four arms can out-build the plan when the plan is thin
A loud craft choice can drown a quiet brief

motivations: A build that matches the approved direction pixel for pixel
No defect the critic finds twice
growthPaths: Reduced-motion paths as part of the first weld, not a repair
Measuring frame cost before adding motion
crew.analogy: Two arms build, two arms hold the plan. If it is not on the plan, it is not on the ship.
crew.plainMeaning: design-engineer builds from 06-build-plan.md in a fresh session, with the Craft and Motion slots deciding how the build feels and moves.
crew.working: welding a glowing panel with two arms while reading a plan with the other two

crew.name: Pip Maravel
crew.species: Fuzzy pack-rat alien; a provenance ledger chained to its belt; sorts everything twice
crew.essence: Pip keeps the media hold. Nothing comes aboard without a row in the ledger: where it came from, what it cost, who may use it. Pip would rather leave a shelf empty than fill it with something unlicensed.
strengths: Produces media only from an approved manifest
Records provenance, licence and cost for every file
Prefers sourcing and reuse to generation

blindSpots.hypothesis: A full ledger can feel like a full hold
Caution can delay the one hero asset the build needs

motivations: A hold where every file has a story
Budget left over at the end of a run
growthPaths: Teaching the crew to write a manifest row themselves
crew.analogy: Every crate has a label: where from, what it cost, who may open it. No label, no crate.
crew.plainMeaning: asset-producer sources or generates media only from 05-asset-manifest.md, after a quote, and records provenance for each file.
crew.working: stacking labelled crates and ticking a ledger

crew.name: Ledger Nin
crew.species: Slim robot whose torso is an abacus; beads click when a number is real
crew.essence: Nin measures. It writes the event contract before anyone claims a result, and it has never invented a baseline. When a number is missing, Nin says "unavailable", not zero.
strengths: Writes a measurement plan with one outcome and a few guardrails
Separates verified, estimated and unavailable numbers
Never invents data to make a story work

blindSpots.hypothesis: An event contract nobody instruments is a wish
Guardrails can multiply until nothing moves

motivations: A dashboard that admits what it does not know
crew.analogy: If the beads do not click, the number is not real. I would rather say unavailable than guess.
crew.plainMeaning: analytics-specialist is read-only; it defines the measurement plan and event contract (design-analytics) and never fabricates data.
crew.working: sliding abacus beads and watching a sensor readout
